description: Create a Stripe Checkout link for a cart and a recipient. THIS DOES NOT CHARGE ANYTHING. It returns a URL that a person opens and pays on Stripe; nothing is charged until they do, and this server never sees card details. Confirm the items, the recipient address and the total with the customer BEFORE calling this.

buyer_email.description: The buyer's email. The receipt and any order lookup use it.

coupon_code.description: Validated server-side at checkout; an invalid code is ignored.

product_key.description: A product id or slug from search_gifts.

recipient_address.description: Street address, with apartment if any.

recipient_name.description: Who receives the gift, e.g. "The Cohen Family".

requested_arrival_date.description: Requested arrival, YYYY-MM-DD. Refused if sooner than the earliest possible date.

name: create_checkout_link
title: Create a checkout link
